{"notes": "Visit 5 (7:45). Nobody spoke while I was there. Picture: fish still fully closed, every domino dark/connected from start around head, body, both lines and tail loop. No gaps. Tight bunching near (28.8, 9-11.5) still the likeliest weak spot at the push. No hands labelled on the table, so nobody was touching it; consistent with the hands-off agreement. I still don't know who placed which pieces, so I'm not crediting building from the picture alone.

Priya: Said earlier 'Agreed, all connected. Hands off, I'll just watch.' Self-reported lower-line and tail work, which the closed fish supports, but unverified. Ask what she placed and how she joined under Leo's end.

Leo: Silent again. Owns the tail and the handoff from visit 3. Ask about the overlap at the meeting point and whether he heard Priya's shout.

Maya: Last heard at 5:15 ('Hands off from here, everyone. Great fish!'). Likely proposed the stop-touching plan (Tom's 'Agreed, Maya'). Good team-closing instinct, but no direct evidence of what she checked or placed. Ask her.

Tom: Agreed with Maya, said he'd stay clear of Leo's side. Sensible caution, no evidence of building. Ask what he did and what the earlier 'Thanks Tom' was about.

Next: watch the push, judge how the fish falls (especially the tail join and the bunched join), then collect each person's account before rating."}
